   1 #!/usr/bin/env bash
   2 # Fixture ROI-content contract: a fixture whose phase-2 comment promises a
   3 # kernel must actually carry that kernel BETWEEN the markers. The compiler
   4 # may legally hoist an inlined kernel above enter_vsim() -- the markers'
   5 # "memory" clobber does not cover statics whose address never escapes --
   6 # which silently empties the ROI (rt_c_matmul shipped that way: markers
   7 # back-to-back, window_cycles ~74 of pure drain overhead). Anchor rule
   8 # (runtime/rt_c_helpers.h): kernels live in a noinline function called
   9 # between the markers.
  10 #
  11 # Checks (static, objdump):
  12 #   rt_c_matmul    span contains the GEMM: a kernel call (jal) or a mul
  13 #   rt_c_v_matmul  span contains the kernel call (control: known-good)
  14 #   rt_c_v_regs    span contains vector instructions (inline V kernel)
  15 set -uo pipefail
  16 
  17 SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
  18 . "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
  19 . "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
  20 
  21 OBJDUMP="${OBJDUMP:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump}}"
  22 OBJDUMP="${OBJDUMP:-riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump}"
  23 command -v "$OBJDUMP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "skip[fixture_roi_content]: no objdump"; exit 77; }
  24 
  25 FIXDIR="$SCRIPT_DIR"
  26 
  27 # Instructions strictly between the ENTER and EXIT markers.
  28 roi_body() {
  29   "$OBJDUMP" -d "$FIXDIR/$1.elf" \
  30     | awk '/5a002013/ { on = 1; next } /5a102013/ { exit } on'
  31 }
  32 
  33 check_roi() {  # $1 = fixture, $2 = required-content regex, $3 = description
  34   BODY=$(roi_body "$1")
  35   if [ -z "$BODY" ]; then
  36     fail "$1: ROI is EMPTY (markers back-to-back) -- kernel hoisted out?"
  37   fi
  38   if ! printf '%s\n' "$BODY" | grep -Eq "$2"; then
  39     echo "--- ROI body of $1 ---"
  40     printf '%s\n' "$BODY"
  41     fail "$1: ROI does not contain $3 (want /$2/)"
  42   fi
  43   ok "$1: ROI carries $3"
  44 }
  45 
  46 check_roi rt_c_matmul   '\sjal\s|\smulw?\s' "the GEMM (kernel call or mul)"
  47 check_roi rt_c_v_matmul '\sjal\s'           "the kernel call"
  48 check_roi rt_c_v_regs   '\sv[a-z0-9.]+\.v'  "vector instructions"
  49 
  50 ok "fixture ROI content"

   3 # CTest gate. Drives tests/*.sh against pre-built artifacts in this
   4 # workspace.
   5 #
   6 # Env overrides:

   8 #   VSIM_PLUGIN  libhybrid_handoff.so (default: qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so)

  11 #   MODE         marker | pc | both  (default: both) - drives TRIGGER_MODE

  13 #                regardless because they assert orchestrator failure
  14 #                modes orthogonal to the trigger mechanism.

  16 #                free(/dev/shm)/256MB)). Each Tier-2 slot uses a 128 MB
  17 #                /dev/shm mmap and runs 2 processes (qemu1, vsim); the
  18 #                headroom check leaves margin for that plus QEMU's own
  19 #                scratch. Pass JOBS=1 for sequential semantics.
  20 #   LOG_DIR      where per-test logs land (default: mktemp -d under /tmp)
  21 
  22 set -euo pipefail
  23 
  24 ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
  25 # vsim sim_* live in the external VSIM_BIN_DIR (setup.sh exports it, mirroring
  26 # VSIM_QEMU); fall back to the legacy in-tree build only if it is unset.
  27 VSIM_BUILD="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-$ROOT/verilator/build}"

  29 TEST_DIR="$ROOT/tests/fixtures"

  31 VSIM_QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64}"
  32 VSIM_PLUGIN="${VSIM_PLUGIN:-$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so}"

  34   # Default to the repo's canonical SINGLE-HART engine (the same one ./andesim
  35   # pins). The fixtures are single-hart programs: on a multicore build like
  36   # sim_ax45mpv_mp2 -- which sorts FIRST under verilator/build/ -- the
  37   # secondary hart runs crt0 from reset, writes SKIPPED to SimControl and
  38   # stops the sim before hart 0 drains, failing every C fixture. Fall back
  39   # to the first sim_* only when the canonical engine is not built.
  40   VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_BUILD/sim_ax45mpv_premium"

  47 ok()   { printf '\033[1;32m[ok]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
  48 warn() { printf '\033[1;33m[skip]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
  49 fail() { printf '\033[1;31m[FAIL]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

  51 require() {
  52   if [[ -z "$2" || ! -e "$2" ]]; then
  53     fail "$1 not found: $2"
  54     fail "build artifacts first: 'source ./setup.sh'"
  55     exit 1
  56   fi

  59 require VSIM_PLUGIN "$VSIM_PLUGIN"
  60 require VSIM_BIN    "$VSIM_BIN"

  65   handoff_roundtrip rt_pc_jump rt_sign_bits rt_abi_aliases rt_long_roi
  66   rt_all_gprs rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh rt_csr_survival rt_shared_mem
  67   rt_c_hello rt_c_printf rt_c_matmul rt_c_v_regs rt_c_v_csrs

  79 # Round-trip fixtures: name|fixture-env-prefix. All run on the unified
  80 # e2e.sh harness (shared /dev/shm mmap). The TRIGGER_MODE env is
  81 # injected per iteration based on $MODE. Negative drivers live in
  82 # NEG_TESTS and run once regardless of mode.
  83 RT_TESTS=(
  84   "handoff_roundtrip|FIXTURE=handoff_roundtrip"
  85   "rt_pc_jump|FIXTURE=rt_pc_jump"
  86   "rt_sign_bits|FIXTURE=rt_sign_bits"

  88   "rt_long_roi|FIXTURE=rt_long_roi"
  89   "rt_all_gprs|FIXTURE=rt_all_gprs"
  90   "rt_mem_loadstore|FIXTURE=rt_mem_loadstore"
  91   "rt_unaligned_lh|FIXTURE=rt_unaligned_lh"
  92   "rt_csr_survival|FIXTURE=rt_csr_survival"

  95   "rt_c_printf|FIXTURE=rt_c_printf"
  96   "rt_c_matmul|FIXTURE=rt_c_matmul TIMEOUT=120"
  97   "rt_c_v_regs|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_regs"
  98   "rt_c_v_csrs|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_csrs"
  99   "rt_c_v_matmul|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_matmul TIMEOUT=120"

 103 NEG_TESTS=(
 104   "rt_corrupt_state|bash $HARNESS/drivers/rt_corrupt_state.sh"
 105 )
 106

 108 case "$MODE" in
 109   marker|pc|both) ;;
 110   *) fail "MODE must be one of marker|pc|both (got: $MODE)"; exit 1 ;;
 111 esac

 113 default_jobs() {
 114   local n=1 shm_free shm_cap
 115   n=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
 116   if [[ -d /dev/shm ]]; then
 117     shm_free=$(df -m --output=avail /dev/shm 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | tr -d ' ')

 133 mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
 134 RESULTS_FILE="$LOG_DIR/results.tsv"
 135 LOCK_FILE="$LOG_DIR/lock"
 136 : > "$RESULTS_FILE"
 137 : > "$LOCK_FILE"

 139 # run_one MODE NAME CMD INDEX TOTAL
 140 # Captures the test command's stdout+stderr into $LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log,
 141 # emits one atomic progress line, and appends a TSV row to $RESULTS_FILE
 142 # (mode<TAB>name<TAB>status<TAB>rc<TAB>elapsed). flock on $LOCK_FILE
 143 # serializes the progress write and the results-file append so concurrent
 144 # children (introduced by the parallel-execution commit) cannot interleave
 145 # their TTY writes or corrupt the tally file.
 146 run_one() {
 147   local mode="$1" name="$2" cmd="$3" idx="$4" total="$5"
 148   local log="$LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log"
 149   local start end elapsed status rc
 150   start=$(date +%s)
 151   set +e
 152   bash -c "$cmd" >"$log" 2>&1
 153   rc=$?
 154   set -e
 155   end=$(date +%s)
 156   elapsed=$((end - start))
 157   case $rc in
 158     0)  status=PASS ;;
 159     77) status=SKIP ;;
 160     *)  status=FAIL ;;
 161   esac
 162   (
 163     flock 9
 164     case "$status" in
 165       PASS) ok   "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (${elapsed}s)" ;;
 166       SKIP) warn "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=77, ${elapsed}s)" ;;
 167       FAIL) fail "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=$rc, ${elapsed}s) -> $log" ;;
 168     esac
 169     printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\n' \
 170       "$mode" "$name" "$status" "$rc" "$elapsed" >> "$RESULTS_FILE"
 171   ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
 172 }

 174 # Build the workplan: one entry per (mode, name, cmd) tuple. Order
 175 # matters: marker-mode tests first, then pc-mode, then negatives (matching
 176 # the original sequential layout so logs are streamed in the same order).
 177 declare -a WORKPLAN=()
 178 for tm in marker pc; do
 179   [[ "$MODE" != "both" && "$MODE" != "$tm" ]] && continue
 180   for entry in "${RT_TESTS[@]}"; do
 181     rt_name="${entry%%|*}"
 182     env_prefix="${entry#*|}"
 183     # B3: anchor the regex so FILTER=rt_csr does not silently also match
 184     # rt_csr_survival. Users who want a substring match pass '.*marker.*'.
 185     [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$rt_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
 186     cmd="TRIGGER_MODE=$tm $env_prefix bash $HARNESS/e2e.sh"
 187     WORKPLAN+=("$tm|$rt_name|$cmd")
 188   done
 189 done
 190 for entry in "${NEG_TESTS[@]}"; do
 191   neg_name="${entry%%|*}"
 192   neg_cmd="${entry#*|}"
 193   [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$neg_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
 194   WORKPLAN+=("neg|$neg_name|$neg_cmd")
 195 done
 196 
 197 TOTAL=${#WORKPLAN[@]}
 198 step "logs: $LOG_DIR  jobs: $JOBS  mode: $MODE  tests: $TOTAL"
 199 
 200 # FIFO-based bounded job pool. Each child reads one token from $SEM_FIFO
 201 # before starting and writes one back on exit; only $JOBS tokens exist,
 202 # so at most $JOBS children run concurrently. Opening the fifo in
 203 # read-write mode (<>) means writes never block the parent. The fifo
 204 # inode is unlinked immediately after fd 8 is bound -- the kernel keeps
 205 # the pipe alive as long as fd 8 is open.
 206 SEM_FIFO="$LOG_DIR/sem.fifo"
 207 mkfifo "$SEM_FIFO"
 208 exec 8<>"$SEM_FIFO"
 209 rm -f "$SEM_FIFO"
 210 for ((sem_i=0; sem_i<JOBS; sem_i++)); do
 211   printf '.\n' >&8
 212 done
 213 
 214 i=0

 216   i=$((i+1))
 217   w_mode="${w%%|*}"
 218   w_rest="${w#*|}"
 219   w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
 220   w_cmd="${w_rest#*|}"

 224     printf '.\n' >&8
 225   ) &

 231 declare -A MODE_FAIL=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
 232 declare -A MODE_SKIP=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
 233 declare -a FAILED_NAMES=()

 237     SKIP) MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]=$((MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
 238     FAIL) MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]=$((MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]+1));

 240   esac

 243 # Stream failed-test logs in workplan order so the user sees a
 244 # deterministic post-run failure dump.

 246   w_mode="${w%%|*}"
 247   w_rest="${w#*|}"
 248   w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
 249   w_status=$(awk -F'\t' -v m="$w_mode" -v n="$w_name" \
 250                  '$1==m&&$2==n{print $3; exit}' "$RESULTS_FILE")
 251   if [[ "$w_status" == "FAIL" ]]; then
 252     echo
 253     echo "=== FAIL log: ${w_name}[${w_mode}] ==="
 254     cat "$LOG_DIR/$w_mode--$w_name.log"
 255   fi
 256 done

 258 echo

 263 total_fail=$((marker_f + pc_f + neg_f))
 264 total_skip=$((marker_s + pc_s + neg_s))
 265 step "summary: marker ${marker_p}p/${marker_f}f/${marker_s}s  pc ${pc_p}p/${pc_f}f/${pc_s}s  neg ${neg_p}p/${neg_f}f/${neg_s}s  total ${total_pass} passed, ${total_fail} failed, ${total_skip} skipped"
 266 if (( total_fail > 0 )); then

#
# Toolchain location comes from the repo-root config.env (loaded by
# `source ./setup.sh`, which exports HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN). Override on the
# command line with `make TOOLCHAIN=/path/to/toolchain ...` if you want
# to bypass the env var.

TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN)
ifeq ($(strip $(TOOLCHAIN)),)
$(error HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN is not set. Run `source ./setup.sh` from the repo root, or pass `TOOLCHAIN=/path/to/toolchain` on the command line)
endif
CC        := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc
LD        := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-ld
OBJDUMP   := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump

# user-facing andesim runtime; fixtures are just one consumer. The linker
# script moved with them (test.ld -> runtime/andesim.ld, same content).
RUNTIME_DIR := ../../runtime
LDSCRIPT    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andesim.ld
# Fixture-only helpers (csr ROI markers; NOT part of the portable runtime).
HELPERS_DIR := runtime

CFLAGS  := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -nostdlib -static -Wall
LDFLAGS := -T $(LDSCRIPT) -nostdlib -static

# All fixtures share andesim.ld (load base 0x00100000, andes_ae350 DRAM).
RT_FIXTURES := rt_all_gprs rt_all_fprs rt_abi_aliases rt_sign_bits rt_pc_jump \
               rt_long_roi rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh \
               rt_shared_mem rt_csr_survival

# through the shipped vplat runtime (libandesim_runtime.a) with the

# artifact. stdio goes out the ATCUART100 UART2 and exit/file-io through
# the SimControl device at 0xe0080000, all of which both QEMU's
# andes_ae350 and vsim model. No semihosting and no libgloss anywhere:
# vplat_syscalls.o in the archive provides every stub newlib needs, so
# the same ELF runs on fast, cycle AND hybrid and a syscall inside the
# ROI works (it just adds its real cycles to the figure).

	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff_roundtrip.o -o $@

$(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $*.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) $*.o -o $@

	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs $< -o $@

	$(CC) $(VPLAT_CFLAGS) -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs $< -o $@

$(VPLAT_RT) &: $(RUNTIME_DEPS)
	$(MAKE) -C $(RUNTIME_DIR)

dump: spin.elf handoff_exit.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d spin.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d handoff_exit.elf

clean:
	rm -f spin.o spin.elf handoff_exit.o handoff_exit.elf \
	      handoff_roundtrip.o handoff_roundtrip.elf \
	      $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.o) $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
	      $(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) $(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
	      $(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf)
